Provide a recipe for a vegan potato wedges.,,Ingredients:

- 2 tsp garlic powder
- 2 tsp smoked paprika
- 1/2 tsp onion powder
- 1/2 tsp ground cumin
- Salt and pepper to taste
Instructions:
